ModMetaData.name: 疫线检疫 Quarantine Line
ModMetaData.author: QuarantineLine
ModMetaData.description:
Spatial quarantine for infectious disease. Mark wards, toggle strict isolation, weigh visit risk vs containment.
Sleeps completely when no infectious disease on player maps. Does not replace vanilla medicine or immunity — only light exposure tweaks (master toggle). Easy mode available.
中文：传染病时才醒的空间检疫。划病房、严格隔离、探视风险与遏制的权衡。健康时完全休眠。不取代原版医药/免疫。
